name: Kaguya
source: Kaguya is Lunatemis' personal maid and number 2 of the organization. She is also Katsuma's childhood friend. Unlike Katsuma she is extremely talented, which, unknown to her, annoys him. Given her own annoyance at Maria calling the protagonist by his first name, it seems Kaguya is quite possessive over Katsuma. She even goes as far as to question the relationship he has with Maria.
